As a rescue manager, I check my application before
adopters see it. Back to editing keeps every change.
Switch to see the form for each species or tag. Dogs-only
and tagged questions appear or disappear.
Only shown categories appear, with how many questions
each holds. Hidden ones like Eligibility are left out.
Exact bank wording and answer choices. All
shown questions are required unless optional.
No red flags in the preview
As an adopter, I never see whether an answer is flagged.
Flags show only to staff, like internal notes.
Landlord questions show only for renters; "If yes"
boxes only after Yes. The preview labels both.
